svg.title: HyperWeave — The artifact layer for agent-human representations.
svg.desc: HyperWeave stacked logo, Primer porcelain variant (fired white glaze, cobalt underglaze — the editorial default). Octahedral mark with faceted volume, glass core, and a lit-to-shadow transmitter highlight, above the HyperWeave wordmark in Orbitron over the tagline THE ARTIFACT LAYER FOR AGENT-HUMAN REPRESENTATIONS. Transparent (light surfaces). v3.1.0: two-line subtitle replaced by a single sentence-case tagline; canvas re-fit 592 -> 560.

hw:reasoning.hw:intent: HyperWeave stacked lockup, Primer porcelain colorway — fired white glaze, cobalt underglaze — the editorial default. Now states the product proposition directly instead of a mood line plus a company credit.
hw:reasoning.hw:approach: Copy-and-fit revision from v3.0.1. The mark geometry, node positions, glass/volume/glow layers, palette, motion vocabulary, wordmark outlines and all accessibility behavior are held byte-identical; only the text block below the wordmark changed. The two tracked all-caps slots (516 / 550) collapse to one sentence-case tagline on the 516 baseline, set in TeX Gyre Heros at 18px and outlined to paths — no webfont, no runtime dependency. Glyphs are emitted once into defs and placed with <use>, so the 50-character line costs 21 outlines instead of 50. Removing the second slot frees 34px, so the viewBox drops 592 -> 560 to restore even ~40px top and bottom margins.
hw:reasoning.hw:tradeoffs: Kept sentence case rather than converting the tagline to the tracked all-caps of the line it replaces: at 50 characters, caps plus tracking runs past the 531px wordmark and inverts the hierarchy, and a proposition reads as a sentence while a mood line reads as a label. Chose glyph outlines over a element so the artifact still renders identically inside GitHub context where no font stack resolves — cost is a text layer that is no longer string-editable, mitigated by the atlas structure and the aria-labelled title. Chose to crop the canvas rather than re-center the whole lockup, so the mark keeps its exact v3.0.1 coordinates and the two versions overlay cleanly. Chose a separate obsidian file over a prefers-color-scheme fork inside one file: README and email surfaces pick assets by URL, not by media query. Subtitle chromatic darkened #5C7C9E -> #4E6B8A and opacity lifted .95 -> 1 because the old value measured 4.37:1 on white and failed AA at body size.
hw:reasoning.hw:spatial-notes: 604x560 (1.08:1), axis of symmetry x=302. Octahedral complex centered (302,213.18) at scale 2.05; vertices r=80 local (mark footprint ~328x328, mark vertical extent 42->384). Top margin 42 (canvas to mark crown), bottom margin 40 (tagline descender ~520 to canvas edge). Mark->wordmark gap 36px (bottom node edge ~384 to wordmark cap 420). Wordmark cap 52px, baseline 472. Single tagline baseline 516 — 44px below the wordmark baseline, cap height 13.1px, run width 405.2px (67% of canvas, 76% of the 531px wordmark), centered on x=302 so the widths nest 328 (mark) < 405 (tagline) < 531 (wordmark) and no edge aligns. Vertical rhythm now descends 42 > 36 > 44 > 40. Faceted faces shaded on a vertical light(-80)->dark(+80) gradient for volume; transmitter glass fill -60..60; inner highlight crown-to-base on a 0.93-scaled concentric path. Five connection nodes (4 vertices r=3.5 + center r=4).
